explanations: String.prototype.replace with a string pattern replaces only the first match. escapeHtml therefore encodes the first &, <, >, " and ' and passes every later one through unchanged. A review with one tag looks escaped, but the second tag is live HTML, and a second double quote in an author name closes the title attribute so the name can add attributes of its own. The fix uses one global regex with a lookup table, which encodes every occurrence of all five characters in a single pass, so each character is encoded exactly once.
